bounded_finding: Under frozen deterministic P2-H14-S01, when the local action returned successfully but the normal EXECUTION_COMPLETED record could not be persisted, the successor attempted a distinct durable uncertainty record and returned an executed=true state marked EXECUTED_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE.
nonclaim: This establishes only the deterministic local successor behavior when the normal completion record fails but the fallback witness write remains available. It does not establish recovery when the ledger as a whole is unavailable, nor external, distributed or production transaction assurance.
